summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Chatbots Want Your Health Records. Tread Carefully.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US disrupts SocksEscort proxy network powered by Linux malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 55 articles published in the last 24 hours
